svg.title: Relay · MacBook Pro and iMac
svg.desc: Relay on a Space Black 16-inch MacBook Pro and green 24-inch iMac. The MacBook shows Design Review; the iMac shows the new-conversation screen. Original Apple product bezels, real Relay screenshots, and an independently editable background. Canvas: 4000 by 2662. The MacBook sits in the foreground over the iMac’s lower-left area. Each device retains its native proportions. Screens are placed without stretching.
svg.metadata: Source bezels: Apple Design Resources, https://developer.apple.com/design/resources/ MacBook Pro: https://devimages-cdn.apple.com/design/resources/download/Bezel-MacBook-Pro-M5.dmg iMac: https://devimages-cdn.apple.com/design/resources/download/Bezel-iMac-M4.dmg Device artwork remains unmodified. Apple retains ownership of its artwork. Screen images: actual Relay captures. Background and screen image nodes are independently replaceable.
